title: HERADÔNIA Director's cut
description:
“HERADÔNIA” is a psychological horror game.STORY

Julia is a simple woman who lives with her husband and daughter in the city of Heradônia.

After arriving home and realizing her husband had left town for work, she notices her house has been ransacked. Thus, Julia begins a journey in search of her daughter, a journey that will force her to confront her deepest secrets—the ones she tried hardest to hide.

HIGHLIGHTS

First-person horror: Play as Julia, a simple woman living with her husband and daughter in the city of Heradônia.

Environments: The world of Heradônia is set in the 2000s. Explore city environments like the school and the city hospital.

GAMEPLAY

• Exploration

• Combat

• Item collection

• Puzzle solving
description_short: REPENTANCE IS THE ONLY WAY TO OVERCOME THE EVILS OF YOUR CORRUPT HEART, THOSE YOU TRIED TO BURY.
